description: Canonical token values for the sketch design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: 'go ->' renders 17px bold Caveat on the white composer.

extras.radius.message.note: JSX: message bubbles are borderRadius 12; the radius table lists 'Message 12'.

extras.radius.avatar.note: JSX: 34px chat avatars are borderRadius 8 (the radius table's 'Component 8').

extras.radius.avatar_small.note: JSX: the 28px account avatar in the sidebar footer is borderRadius 7.

extras.radius.badge.note: JSX: the 18px unread badge is borderRadius 6.

extras.radius.checkbox.note: No checkbox or radio in the JSX. 20px boxes take the badge radius (6) so small squares share one rounding; radios stay rounded squares like the avatars.

extras.radius.knob.note: No toggle in the JSX. The 16px toggle knob is a rounded square at 4, a step below the checkbox's 6.

extras.radius.icon.note: No icon tiles in the JSX. The 24px icon placeholder tile takes the knob's 4.

color.surface.note: JSX swatch 'Surface' #F0EDE8 — AI bubbles, selected rows, avatars.

color.accent_foreground.note: JSX swatch 'On Accent' #FFFFFF (unread badge). Measures ~2.2:1 — flagged for the contrast gate; the JSX's own table claims 4.1:1.

color.action.note: 'go ->' send label is accent purple Caveat text. Contrast fix (#7): #B8A9C8 -> #7F718E. Kept equal to accent (Sketch has one purple); passes the 'go ->' text pair and white-on-action. [color.action on color.surface_elevated 2.2:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 3.0:1); color.action_foreground on color.action 2.2:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.danger.note: Sketch's palette is neutrals + one purple. Muted brick red in the same low-chroma register (4.9:1 with white).

color.focus_ring.note: No focus spec in the JSX. Derived by darkening the accent 'Dark (hover)' #9A8BAA until it reaches 3:1 on both page (4.0:1) and surface (3.6:1).

radius.chrome.note: Live app shell is 14px; the JSX radius table lists 16px 'App shell' (extras.radius.app_shell_doc).

font.mono.note: No mono in the JSX; IBM Plex Mono is the sibling of the structural face.

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; 14px is the recurring sidebar gutter.

motion.fast.note: JSX .snd send label: 'transition: transform 0.1s', hover scale(1.05). exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s linear', 60ms stagger; selection doc row '200ms ease'. Linear comes from the CSS block, which matches Terminal/Revolt verbatim and is probably copied. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.25s linear', 80ms stagger. The doc row says '400ms ease, 80ms stagger'; the implementation value is used. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.expressive.note: Not used by the JSX. Takes the doc row's 400ms ease; the spring wobble (bounce .2) is derived from the hand-drawn grammar.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Reduced motion keeps opacity entrances and drops travel and the hover scale.

extras.color.chip_hover.note: Suggestion chip hover fill (live CSS .bc:hover; JSX component spec 'hover.bg').

color.accent.note: Contrast fix (#7): #B8A9C8 -> #7F718E. The selection bar/unread marks need 3:1 on surface (min. move #9283A1); white text then needs 4.5:1, so the lavender moves on to #7F718E (lightness only, hue 307 / chroma 0.047 kept) rather than turning the white label near-black (#222222, a 0.75 lightness move). [color.accent on color.surface 1.88:1 -> 3.86:1 (min 3.0:1); color.accent_foreground on color.accent 2.2:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.border_input.note: Contrast fix (#7): #E5E3DE -> #8A8984. Search and composer are identified by their 1px stroke (the white composer fill is ~1.15:1 on surface); minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept. [color.border_input on color.surface 1.1:1 -> 3.0:1 (min 3.0:1)]
